# Sign-In

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/signin@v1.10.4` · last audited 2026-10-24 (`7b35a020d`)

### Known gaps

- IAM / resource-policy evaluation: permission statements are stored and rendered by GetResourcePolicy but never evaluated (out of scope).

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- No browser authorize flow or console session: /_gopherstack/signin/authorize is an emulator-only endpoint that mints a code for the calling identity in place of the interactive sign-in page.
